subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ300D across its F-Pace X761 application.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ300D is a single-application engine within the Jaguar range - exclusively the F-Pace D300.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, complete gasket and seal set, timing chain components where required, and the oil filter housing gasket as standard. We also inspect the twin-turbocharger, EGR and DPF systems.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the AJ300D. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ300D rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ300D REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine - illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ300D is part of Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium family of engines. A full rebuild involves a complete strip-down, inspection, and measurement of all critical components. The timing chain system is a known critical wear point on some Ingenium engines and is inspected thoroughly on every rebuild.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, complete gasket and seal set, timing chain components where required, oil filter housing gasket

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
